title: Cloud Security: campaign pricing
content:
Cloud Security uses the following tier-specific bases for campaign pricing.

## Basis

Campaign discount fraction: Discount fraction for a recorded eligible campaign on primary usage; decimal.

Campaign-eligible channels: Channels eligible for campaign pricing; string list.

## Tier values

| Security tier | Campaign discount fraction | Campaign-eligible channels |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Cloud Security 50 Workloads | 0.05 | portal, API |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 100 Workloads | 0.05 | portal, API |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 250 Workloads | 0.05 | portal, API |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 500 Workloads | 0.05 | portal, API |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 1000 Workloads | 0.05 | portal, API |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 2500 Workloads | 0.05 | portal, API |

## Tier comparison

The listed campaign pricing bases are the same across these six Security tiers.
